body:
![medium](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/medium-priority.svg)

According to the repository's general rules, when using negative boolean properties in JSON planning or configuration artifacts, we must explicitly document their semantics (e.g., using a `_semantics` field) to clarify the boolean logic and ensure they have an explicit stop-rule meaning.

Please add a corresponding `_semantics` field for `must_not_be_default_student_surface` to document its stop-rule behavior. Additionally, do not rerun generator scripts after manually adding this metadata to prevent overwriting the manual changes.

```suggestion
      "must_not_be_default_student_surface": true,
      "_semantics": {
        "must_not_be_default_student_surface": "Stop-rule: Prevents historical whole-question screenshots from being served as the primary student-facing surface by default."
      },
```

<details>
<summary>References</summary>

1. When using negative boolean properties in JSON planning or configuration artifacts, explicitly document their semantics (e.g., using a _semantics field) to clarify the boolean logic and ensure they have an explicit stop-rule meaning.
2. Do not rerun generator scripts after manually adding review metadata (such as _semantics fields) to generated JSON artifacts, as rerunning the generator will overwrite the manually added metadata.
</details>
